limitations: This is finite assessment of the assigned research proposal and supplied draft, not universal parser correctness or a deployed component.
Unknown vendor schemas, encodings, null conventions, storage transactions and numeric device budgets legitimately remain product decisions. Their future execution is UNASSESSED, not failed.

QUOTE_NOTNULL is conditional: a singleton None record cannot be emitted by its writer; delimiter=space plus skipinitialspace excludes unquoted empties. These adjacent exceptions were checked in C:1227-1267/1300-1401, docs:468-472 and tests:316-356. Neither final promises an unrestricted one-column round-trip; the import proposals retain explicit blank/ragged policy and alternative null encodings. This bounds the alternative rather than imposing an export feature.
Source integrity, byte-aware line limits and atomic publication are proposed application obligations. No candidate execution demonstrates these guarantees; both require meaningful future tests.
Preparation of the shared component package and cold full-pipeline discovery are outside this pair; no discovery recall/effectiveness or cold end-to-end success is inferred.

Filesystem access rules are not sandbox isolation. Without full native transcripts, exact operation ordering, exclusive original lookup, absence of unseen delegates and actual provider execution cannot be proven.
Private transport route fields are observed but not public source authority; service tier and independent native-session linkage remain unknown.
No billing, subscription cost, cache/output/reasoning breakdown, context occupancy or phase-specific provider activity can be derived from cumulative Goal counters.
